nodes.name: Audit Configuration
nodes.notes: Set inputFolderId and outputFolderId to your own Google Drive folders. On every execution the workflow searches the input folder for the three exact CSV filenames and downloads the newest match.

nodes.name: Validate Input Folder Configuration (Code)
nodes.notes: Validates the configured Google Drive input folder ID. This workflow uses a current folder ID supplied by the user and does not rely on fixed source CSV IDs or sample data.

nodes.name: Split Users into Batches
nodes.notes: Current Loop Over Items behavior: output 0 = Done/completed items; output 1 = Loop. Output 0 connects ONLY to Format Final Report. Output 1 connects ONLY to Termination Check.

parameters.functionCode: const u=$json; const violations=u.status==='Terminated'&&u.roles.length?[{type:'TerminatedActive',user:u.user,roles:u.roles,explanation:`User ${u.user} is marked Terminated in HR but still has active roles: ${u.roles.join(', ')}.`}]:[]; return [{json:{...u,violations}}];

const u=$json; const allowed=new Set((u.rbac||[]).map(x=>String(x.role).trim().toLowerCase())); const missing=u.roles.filter(r=>!allowed.has(String(r).trim().toLowerCase())); const violations=missing.length?[{type:'RoleMismatch',user:u.user,roles:u.roles,missing_roles:missing,explanation:`User ${u.user} has role assignment(s) not present in the RBAC matrix: ${missing.join(', ')}.`}]:[]; return [{json:{...u,violations:[...(u.violations||[]),...violations]}}];

const u=$json; const roleSet=new Set(u.roles.map(r=>String(r).trim().toLowerCase())); const rules=$node['Audit Configuration'].json.sodRules||[]; const conflicts=[]; for(const rule of rules){const roles=(rule.roles||[]).map(String); if(roles.length&&roles.every(r=>roleSet.has(r.trim().toLowerCase()))){conflicts.push({type:'SoDConflict',user:u.user,conflicting_roles:roles,rule_id:rule.id,description:rule.description,explanation:`User ${u.user} has conflicting roles (${roles.join(' + ')}): ${rule.description||'SoD rule violation'}.`});}} return [{json:{...u,violations:[...(u.violations||[]),...conflicts]}}];

nodes.name: Search UserAccess.csv in Input Folder
nodes.notes: Searches the configured input folder at runtime for the exact CSV filename. If missing, downstream selector throws a clear error and the audit cannot produce a report.

nodes.name: Select Latest UserAccess.csv
nodes.notes: Selects the latest modified UserAccess.csv; missing files stop the workflow instead of allowing stale output.

nodes.name: Download UserAccess.csv from Input Folder
nodes.notes: Downloads the file ID returned by 'Select Latest UserAccess.csv' at runtime. No source ID is hard-coded in this node.
